articles.title: Dubai Police warn of dangers of driving while fatigued after a driver faints causing an accident in Umm Suqeim
articles.excerpt: An accident took place on Umm Suqeim Street, heading towards Jumeirah Street, when a driver lost control of the vehicle after losing consciousness. This led to the vehicle veering off course and crashing into other cars. Dubai Police warned of driving while fatigued.

articles.note: Search on gulfnews.com and web search returned no article covering this driver fainting accident on Umm Suqeim Street.
No direct public article URL reachable on dubaipolice.gov.ae (connection reset / client-side SPA shell); official statement was distributed as a press release to media outlets.

articles.title: 'Don't risk it': Dubai Police issue warning after driver faints, causes collision | Khaleej Times
articles.excerpt: Dubai Police warned motorists against driving when fatigued or experiencing health issues that affect vehicle control. The warning followed a collision on Umm Suqeim Street towards Jumeirah Street, where a driver lost consciousness, veering off course and colliding with another vehicle.
